translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

content: Nammari aufiu ufafa.
Karaambaiqa Nooana maaqi qimasee qimaminau. Anee aneenna aiku asauku faqa sipaki keeqaa. Maqa saaqaraasakiqari anee kai aneennaraa andeeqarafa mariana qafaidaqa.

Innee qini qifusaa anukara aandau fee qimariana qisauku dinni taikasee dinni oonu qaara marasee 7 akoona faqa anaasee faqa ani faqa sipaki mareeqee quqasainaqa asumu mariaqa. Innee qini qifusaa sia anukara aandau oosana oosana akoona faqa anaasee faqa moodaa kai mareeqee minaki asumu quqasaina mariaqa.
Aiqama ufini oosana oosana dinni taikasee dinni oonu qaara marasee 7 akoona faqa anaasee faqa mareeqee sipaki quqaa. Miqimmasainaqa aiqama aandau ufini kaifaa maa maqanasaa moomoo kiaqa.

Dinni taikasee dinni oonu qaaraqanda marasee 7 faasaana aiqarainaqa miqoo aaku maqasaa quqaanaura. Qaara fasiqa niku nisauku taikasee 40 faasaana faqa eendaki faqa aaku rida mariannoo. Miqi marinaqa qinee maqasaa aiqama naanna faqaasa qeeqa auqu nisaafanausa taika nisaanaura.
Nooafa aiqama ainaina Anutufa qimamundee kaimminau.
Nooafa 600 aukuana marasoofanoo mi aukuannasaa nammari aufirafa aninau.
Nooafa Anutuna mi ufausa iriseenoo rufiaseenoo narí faqa narí anaaqa faqa narí amaaku qaaramoo namu faqa minamusa ninaaqmaaka faqa sipaki keeqaqau.
Oosana oosana aandau ufini akoona faqa anaasee faqa Anutuna afusaa anukarausa faqa sia anukarausa faqa aiqama Nooana faqa sipaki keeqaqau. Anutufa ufa qumau kai keeqaqau.
Dinni taikasee dinni oonu qaara marasee 7 faasana marinoo nammari aufinau.

Mi aukuanna Nooafa 600 aukuana maranau. Qaara quqoonasaa qiku dinni taikasee dinni oonu qaaraqanda marasee 17 faasaanasaa mi faasaanna kai nammari radiqinau. Mi faasaanna kai maqa ameemaanaindari nammari radiqisee urureenoo innaaruna kooqiara foora atuqoofanoo aaku firaafa nammariara foora adianau.
Qaara fasiqa niku nisauku taikasee 40 eendaki faqa faasaana faqa aaku firaafa nammariara foora adianau.
Nammari radiqu faasaanna mi faasaanna kai Nooafa narí aanaaqandiri faqa narí amaaku namu Seemafa faqa Qammafa faqa Yafeetafa faqa minamusa nári ninaaqmaaka faqa sipaki keeqafiqa mariqau.
Kaasau aandau oosana oosana faqa maaqeena aandau oosana oosana faqa ufini oosana oosana faqa firaa aandauqa faqa kaqikaa aandauqa faqa Nooana aiku asauku faqa sipaki keeqaqau.
Aiqama oosana oosana kasimaru aandau ufinisa akoona faqa anaasee faqa Nooana faqa sipaki keeqaqau.
Anutufa Nooana qimamu mau kai keeqa fufanoo Anutufa narí kai kooqi itita nimaqanau.
Qaara fasiqa niku nisauku taikasee 40 faasana aaku nammariara foora adianau. Miqi ufanoo nammari qumbiqeenoo sipa uqeereeqeenoo murusaqa quqanau.
Nammari fannoo firaaqoo innooqoofanoo sipa fannoo mina amuaqumau nimarinau.
Nammari fannoo moo faqa innooqeenoo aiqama kisaaqa aaqana dukuninau.
Kaifaa innooqeenoo kisaaqa aaqana oori aaqaramaseenoo 7 meters amana ooru marinau.
Miqinoo marufanoo maqasaa maru ainainausa aiqama kuqiqau. Aiqama ufiniuqa faqa aiqama andauqa faqa aiqama fasiqa anaasee faqa kuqu taikaqau.
Aiqama aandau faqa doodaani faqa maa maqanasaa marusa kuqu taikaqau.

Karaambaiqa aiqama ainaina maqasaaqaraa ainaina taika uqanna sanau. Faiqí anaasee faqa aandau faqa ufini faqa taikannisanau. Nooafa kai narí aiku asauku faqa narí sipakinaa ainainauqa faqa misa kai asumu mariqau.
Dinni qisauku taikasee dinni oonu qaara fasiqa maraseenoo moodaa fasiqa asaukuqara 150 faasaana nammari kaqi aufinoo marinau.
